scope: Minimal host router lifetime fix and isolated actual-source frontend regressions. Candidate builds and real U05 runtime acceptance are owned by the separate build and root agents.

change.behavior: BrowserRouter now surrounds SessionStatusGate so navigation callbacks retain the live history listener when a session commit retires the page subtree.
preserved: SessionStatusGate physically remounts private page state when logical session or context epoch changes
Context epoch changes synchronously cancel and clear the shared QueryClient
Auth store continues to abort the retired context lifetime and clear profile and selected application
Ordinary refresh preserves the logical context and page drafts
change.other_changes: New real-source login browser suite, bootstrap hierarchy regression, npm entrypoint, full browser runner registration and browser documentation. No LoginPage or backend implementation change.

runtime.fixture: Owned Vite server on a dynamically allocated loopback port, fresh browser contexts, real production main/App/LoginPage/auth coordinator, isolated HTTP responses and suppressed external WebSocket connections. No real credentials, backend, or database used.

before_fix_reproduction.test_revision: Initial revision of the added browser regression, before the runtime fix and later isolation assertions. The same protected-layout assertion remains in the final regression.
before_fix_reproduction.failed_assertion: Accepted login mounts the protected layout and requests profile
before_fix_reproduction.interpretation: The address changed through the retired router history while the new router still rendered LoginPage. URL-only assertions do not detect this defect.

scenarios.name: Explicit encoded return path, query and hash
assertions: Anonymous browser uses the actual credential form, tenant selection and organization selection
Accepted context is followed by a profile request using the committed platform session
Address exactly matches the requested protected path, query and hash; protected navigation renders and the login form disappears
A real 401 response followed by one OAuth refresh preserves context epoch, cache, private draft and the original input DOM node
Actual switchContext replaces the organization, unmounts the old private input node, renders an empty form and clears the prior private cache
The real sidebar still navigates to dashboard after the organization switch

scenarios.name: Default dashboard and actual UI logout
assertions: Fresh UI login without a return parameter renders dashboard and requests profile
User menu logout completes the actual logout request and renders the login form at the login address
Protected navigation is absent and the auth store is anonymous after logout

after_fix_late_response_browser.command: SAAS_TEST_BROWSER=msedge PHASE9_BROWSER_FILTER='cross organization rejects' node tests/phase9-navigation-browser.mjs
assertions: The prior context request receives its actual late HTTP 200 response even though its native abort has been detached
Production still receives the real signal and aborts the retired context before the response arrives
The old menu never enters the current query cache or visible palette/recent navigation
No old micro-application entry or app-context request is made

lint.warning_scope: Existing warnings in other files; this fix only changes main.tsx runtime source and adds no lint warning.

diff_whitespace.command: git diff --check -- frontend/src/main.tsx frontend/tests/session-integration.mjs frontend/tests/browser/run.mjs frontend/tests/browser/README.md frontend/package.json

independent_review.conclusion: Router placement matches the installed react-router history listener lifetime, preserves existing private subtree retirement, and needs no LoginPage change.

real_u05_attempt02_context.source: Root and frontend build agents' private browser-validation-02 evidence; independently reported to the repair agent
real_u05_attempt02_context.interpretation: Real U05 attempt02 identifies the same old-router notification defect. This record does not claim the repaired source has passed real U05 runtime acceptance.
